summary: First iteration end-to-end testing of LITIX Capacitación. Backend: 21/21 pytest pass (root, categories, courses CRUD + filters, auth login/me/logout, contact submit + admin manage). Frontend: Home/Cursos/CourseDetail/Contacto/AdminLogin/AdminDashboard all load. Contact form submits with success toast. Admin login → dashboard works. Contact message appears in admin Messages tab. Logout works. Image upload not tested via UI (would require real image, skipped). All core flows working.

issues: Background noise: /api/auth/me returns 401 on every page load when unauthenticated, producing console errors. Consider suppressing or only calling /me when a token is present in storage to keep console clean.

action_items: (Optional) Suppress /api/auth/me probe on public pages when no Bearer token exists in localStorage to remove noisy 401s in browser console.

(Optional) Add data-testid attributes consistently. Most pages have them, but a few elements (admin logout button uses text 'Salir', some dashboard tabs) could benefit from explicit data-testid for automation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); consider migrating to lifespan context manager.

Object storage init occurs at startup AND lazily inside put_object/get_object; the global storage_key is fine but failure mode silently logs and returns None — uploads will 503 if Emergent storage init fails. Acceptable for MVP.
JWT_SECRET is read from .env (good). bcrypt is used correctly with $2b$ hash. seed_admin is idempotent and updates password if changed — good.
CORS uses explicit origins with allow_credentials=True (good for httpOnly cookie cross-site flow).
No rate limiting / brute force lockout on /api/auth/login. Out of scope for MVP but flag for hardening.
PUT /api/courses regenerates slug only when missing, but slug collision uses course_id[:6] suffix — fine.
All endpoints exclude {'_id': 0} when reading from Mongo — good practice followed consistently.
Frontend Home page renders correctly with hero, pillars, featured courses, footer (verified visually). Course detail page uses slug routing as expected.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST courses & contact messages via the API during testing. DB restored to 6 demo courses + 0 messages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_litix_backend.py covers all endpoints (run: pytest backend/tests/test_litix_backend.py -v). Admin testids: admin-login-email, admin-login-password, admin-login-submit. Contact form testids: contact-input-name/email/phone/message + contact-submit-button. Course cards use [data-testid^='course-card']. Logout button is labeled 'Salir' (no testid, use text selector). Image upload endpoint /api/uploads/image NOT tested via UI in this iteration (would need a real image file upload).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All requested features verified working end-to-end.
